digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and sign-review recovery classification
propositions: When attestation write fails and the PASS sidecar did not persist, sign-review advertises a recovery path (rebar sign-review) that cannot work because no signable PASS record exists
The recorded verdict incorrectly remains the previous round's BLOCK instead of being absent, creating a stale contradicting state
classify_plan_review_attestation lacks a discriminator to detect sidecar_emitted=False and must branch on this condition before the catch-all to classify such failures separately
The recovery message for sidecar loss must direct users to rebar review-plan without mentioning sign-review and must warn that the recorded verdict is stale
